name: ClawMail
description: Create ClawMail inboxes and send, read, and reply to email.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: ClawMail API key returned by registration at https://api.clawmail.me/v1/register. See https://clawmail.me/SKILL.md.

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: List ClawMail inboxes available to this API key.

tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create another inbox under an existing ClawMail account.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Get a ClawMail inbox by ID.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages in a ClawMail inbox, newest first.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Next cursor from the previous response.

since.description: Return messages received after this timestamp.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read a ClawMail message and its safety scan results by ID.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

message_id.description: Message ID returned by the provider.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Queue an email from a ClawMail inbox to recipients specified by the user.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

to.description: Recipient email address or list of addresses.

cc.description: CC address or list of addresses.

bcc.description: BCC address or list of addresses.

in_reply_to.description: Parent message ID from this inbox for threading.

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Reply to the original sender of a ClawMail message.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

message_id.description: Message ID returned by the provider.

cc.description: CC address or list of addresses.

bcc.description: BCC address or list of addresses.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: List messages in a ClawMail thread, oldest first.

inbox_id.description: Inbox ID returned by list_inboxes or create_inbox.

thread_id.description: Thread ID returned by the provider.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Next cursor from the previous response.
